prompt:
Do most of pipeline's sink threads stay idle while one or a few do all the work? If so, which sinks are idle?

Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: no

## Sink workload

Across the whole trace (0–30,622 ms), none of the four sinks was idle: sink-0 (TID 642973) ran 22.7% of the time, sink-1 (642974) 22.7%, sink-2 (642975) 23.0%, and sink-3 (642976) 21.1%. Their CPU times were similar—6,340.5 to 6,895.5 ms—and the comparison found no difference among them.

They were blocked for about 76–78% of the window, but were waiting for work from the parser, not idle while another sink did their work. The sinks processed work one after another as it arrived; on average, 1.02 of the four ran at once.

The parser (TID 642977) ran more than any individual sink, at 42.4%, but Trace Compass classifies its hold-up as minor, with its pace mostly set by the reader (TID 642978). No sink is identified as idle.
